studies.title: The polar bear
studies.caption: A polar bear moves between sea ice and open water. Its place in Arctic life was well established before distant courts acquired living bears as rarities.
studies.prompt: Wide Arctic sea-ice landscape with one full-body polar bear Ursus maritimus walking in side profile across a low ice floe, creamy fur, long neck, black nose, small ears and large paws. Open dark water beyond, realistic weight on all limbs, no penguins or humans.
